test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Figure 1 and 2 are related with each other in some particular way. Find the relationship and establish the same relationship between 3 and 4 from the given four alternatives. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/895f2b19053ae2bda099f83ca59ccf3ed8cf2e4dfd9b3f2651a06cb7fad80bf3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: Figure 1 transforms into Figure 2 by **reversing the orientation (mirror effect) along with preserving the junction structure and line count**. The same transformation must be applied from Figure 3 to find the correct matching figure in Figure 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e83d7f3ff724d33887f71d61e3e6bd034fb3c4b3005c5b7c5f6082aca9de8bd3.png] 

Now, checking the Options:

Option 1 (A): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a09ba905292a2ecd4419bddd26ff1254e4a2f247eaf06634a909045359d65835.png] 

Preserves the correct number of line branches and shows proper mirrored transformation of Figure 3 – Follows the rule

Option 2 (B): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33f630f677169f64d10b61914253cea676edc2fc4b971a1182f1abe41a5547ea.png] 

Contains only a single downward arrow, missing branch structure – Does not follow the rule

Option 3 (C): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80bfed1362f5b30855cd9fcd4bcc482a54225b6d22ebd2c5c6b77dba1a050b4c.png] 

Structure does not match the required mirrored orientation – Does not follow the rule

Option 4 (D): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc89b77e1acd07b19ec70413a07bd46570289a6a09e88c5295907a09e7dc67b2.png] 

Branch structure is incorrect and does not align with transformation pattern – Does not follow the rule

Hence, **Option 1** is the correct answer.
